tools.name: cheapest_today
tools.description:
The five cheapest energy offers in the Netherlands for a standard household profile on the most
recent day with data, with a coarse cost split (supply, taxes and levies, network, feed-in, one-off)
and the time each price was fetched. profile: one of methodology()'s standard profiles, e.g. 'median',

tools.name: cheapest_history
tools.description:
The five cheapest offers per day for a standard profile over a date range (ISO dates, inclusive;
both optional). A missing day had no valid run.

tools.name: market_summary
tools.description:
Market aggregates for one day (ISO date; default the most recent) and profile: offers priced per
contract type, median yearly cost, spread between cheapest and priciest, offers with cashback, offers
added and withdrawn that day.

tools.name: offer_lifecycle
tools.description:
When each offer was first seen on sale and when it was withdrawn (empty = still on sale), across
every supplier we track; optionally filtered by supplier code (e.g. 'eneco').

tools.name: methodology
tools.description: How Switchje ranks offers, the standard profiles spelled out, the licence and how to attribute.
